commit.message:
Onboard kill-me to the live-preview lane (Stage 4b)

Wire kill-me's slot chart to optionally host Glimmung's generic
live-preview-edge in front of its own stable backend on a preview lease,
mirroring glimmung/k8s/issue. OFF by default (livePreview.enabled=false) so a
normal/CI/prod/validation render is functionally identical to today — the
faithful image-deploy lane is untouched.

- values.yaml: add livePreview block (enabled:false; edge image with empty tag
  Glimmung --sets at provision; upstream http://127.0.0.1:3000; backendPrefixes;
  authorizedSubject; override volume).
- helpers.tpl: kill-me.appPortName — backend port name stays "http" when off,
  flips to "app-internal" when the edge fronts it (keeps disabled render
  byte-identical).
- deployment.yaml: backend container port becomes the named app port (3000
  unchanged); probes follow the name; live-preview-edge.container + .volume
  included gated on livePreview.enabled; replicas via live-preview-edge.replicas
  (single serving pod), include gated so the chart renders standalone without
  the vendored library.
- service.yaml: targetPort flips to the edge's served port when enabled (else
  "http"), include gated for standalone render.
- .gitignore: ignore charts/ — Glimmung vendors the partial at provision time
  (cluster ConfigMap, not a committed copy, not a Helm dependency).

Auth: the edge validates pushes via auth.romaine.life JWKS (public RS256 over
HTTPS); no projected SA token is added to the slot pod.

Refs glimmung docs/live-preview-plan.md "Stage 4a landed contracts".
